body.name: cardinality-uniform tagged latent-overlap POMDP experiment class
body.construction:
For fixed \(0<M_1<\sqrt{M_2}\), let \(\mathcal M_T(t_0,\zeta,C)\) be the set of tagged experiments
\[
 M=(D,\mathcal H,K,\mathcal L_M(\mathsf O_T)),
 \qquad D=(\mathcal X,\mathcal A,b,e),
\]
for which \(T\in\mathbb N\), \(\mathcal X\), \(\mathcal H\), and the nonempty action alphabet \(\mathcal A\) are finite with unrestricted cardinalities, \(D\) is supplied to the decision rule, and the seven predicates \(\mathrm{ass{:}pomdp\text{-}kernel}\), \(\mathrm{ass{:}sequential\text{-}ignorability}\), \(\mathrm{ass{:}stationary\text{-}start}\), the conditional moment envelope \(\mathrm{ass{:}bounded\text{-}reward}\), \(\mathrm{ass{:}policy\text{-}overlap}\), \(\mathrm{ass{:}uniform\text{-}contraction}\), and \(\mathrm{ass{:}latent\text{-}stationary\text{-}overlap}\) hold.  The fixed moment-envelope parameters \((M_1,M_2)\) are suppressed from the notation \(\mathcal M_T(t_0,\zeta,C)\).
